initiatives.name: Industrial Operating Structure Optimization
initiatives.summary: Following a comprehensive portfolio review, Glencore implemented organizational changes to optimize departmental management and reporting, including creating the Nickel-Zinc department and realizing synergies in marketing operations. The company identified approximately $1 billion in cost saving opportunities across 300+ initiatives.

evidence.title: Industrial operating structure streamlined and optimized
evidence.summary: Following a comprehensive portfolio review, Glencore implemented organizational changes to optimize departmental management and reporting, including creating the Nickel-Zinc department and realizing synergies in marketing operations. The company identified approximately $1 billion in cost saving opportunities across 300+ initiatives.
evidence.quote: Following a comprehensive review of our industrial portfolio, we identified opportunities to streamline our industrial operating structure in order to optimise departmental management and reporting, support enhanced technical expertise and increase operational focus. Several organisational changes were made across our businesses, including the creation of the Nickel-Zinc department from two separate departments

initiatives.name: Viterra Agriculture Business Divestment
initiatives.summary: Glencore successfully completed the sale of its agriculture business, Viterra, to Bunge in July 2025. The proceeds from this transaction allowed for an additional share buyback program which was completed.

evidence.title: Viterra agriculture business sale completed
evidence.summary: Glencore successfully completed the sale of its agriculture business, Viterra, to Bunge in July 2025. The proceeds from this transaction allowed for an additional share buyback program which was completed.
evidence.quote: In July, we successfully completed the sale of our agriculture business, Viterra. The proceeds received from this transaction allowed for an additional share buyback, which we completed last month.

initiatives.name: Portfolio Simplification Asset Disposals
initiatives.summary: Glencore disposed of its Pasar copper smelter in the Philippines and the Puerto Nuevo coal export terminal in Colombia as part of ongoing asset base simplification efforts.

evidence.title: Asset disposals for portfolio simplification
evidence.summary: Glencore disposed of its Pasar copper smelter in the Philippines and the Puerto Nuevo coal export terminal in Colombia as part of ongoing asset base simplification efforts.
evidence.quote: simplification of our asset base through the disposals of our Pasar copper smelter in the Philippines, and the Puerto Nuevo coal export terminal in Colombia

initiatives.name: DOJ Compliance Monitorships Resolution
initiatives.summary: The US Department of Justice informed Glencore of the early termination of compliance monitorships, originally expected to conclude after three years. This reflects significant progress in enhancing the Ethics and Compliance Programme.

evidence.title: Early termination of DOJ monitorships
evidence.summary: The US Department of Justice informed Glencore of the early termination of compliance monitorships, originally expected to conclude after three years. This reflects significant progress in enhancing the Ethics and Compliance Programme.
evidence.quote: Although the monitorships were originally expected to conclude after three years, the US Department of Justice (DOJ) informed us that they had reviewed our monitorships and were terminating them earlier than anticipated.

initiatives.name: Industrial Emissions Reduction Programme
initiatives.summary: Glencore's scope 1, 2 and 3 industrial emissions were down 28% compared to restated 2019 baseline, exceeding the 15% target by end of 2026. The company maintains targets of 25% reduction by 2030 and 50% by 2035.

evidence.title: Industrial emissions reduction targets on track
evidence.summary: Glencore's scope 1, 2 and 3 industrial emissions were down 28% compared to restated 2019 baseline, exceeding the 15% target by end of 2026. The company maintains targets of 25% reduction by 2030 and 50% by 2035.
evidence.quote: As of the end of 2025, our scope 1, 2 and 3 industrial emissions* were down 28% compared to our restated 2019 baseline.

initiatives.name: Transition Metals Capital Allocation Strategy
initiatives.summary: Glencore's 2025 industrial capital expenditure of $7.6 billion was weighted towards transition-enabling commodities, with 55% allocated to copper, cobalt, zinc, nickel and custom metallurgical assets. 36% specifically went to copper assets.

evidence.title: Industrial capital expenditure focused on transition metals
evidence.summary: Glencore's 2025 industrial capital expenditure of $7.6 billion was weighted towards transition-enabling commodities, with 55% allocated to copper, cobalt, zinc, nickel and custom metallurgical assets. 36% specifically went to copper assets.
evidence.quote: In 2025, our total capital expenditure on industrial assets◊ was $7.6 billion (2024: $7.1 billion), of which 36% was for our copper assets, 10% for zinc and 6% for nickel.

initiatives.name: KCC Land Access Development
initiatives.summary: In February 2026, Glencore announced the finalization of the KCC land access package with Gécamines, unlocking life of mine extension, productivity and cost improvements and the pathway to c.300ktpa of copper production.

evidence.title: KCC land access package finalized
evidence.summary: In February 2026, Glencore announced the finalization of the KCC land access package with Gécamines, unlocking life of mine extension, productivity and cost improvements and the pathway to c.300ktpa of copper production.
evidence.quote: In February 2026, we also announced the finalisation of the KCC land access package with Gécamines, unlocking life of mine extension, productivity and cost improvements and the pathway to c.300ktpa of copper production.

initiatives.name: Argentine Copper Growth Pipeline (El Pachón & Agua Rica)
initiatives.summary: Glencore is progressing several key copper projects including El Pachón and Agua Rica RIGI applications in Argentina and the restart of Alumbrera operations. The company targets becoming one of the world's largest copper producers with over 1 million tonnes annually by end of 2028 and c.1.6 million tonnes by 2035.

evidence.title: Major copper growth pipeline development
evidence.summary: Glencore is progressing several key copper projects including El Pachón and Agua Rica RIGI applications in Argentina and the restart of Alumbrera operations. The company targets becoming one of the world's largest copper producers with over 1 million tonnes annually by end of 2028 and c.1.6 million tonnes by 2035.
evidence.quote: In H2 2025, we formally applied for inclusion of El Pachón and Agua Rica into Argentina's RIGI incentive regime, and announced the restart of our Alumbrera operations, with initial production expected in H1 2028.

initiatives.name: Quechua Copper Project Acquisition
initiatives.summary: Glencore acquired the Quechua copper project in Peru as part of the Antapaccay district. This represents continued portfolio optimization focused on copper assets.

evidence.title: Quechua copper project acquisition in Peru

initiatives.name: DRC Assets Partnership Exploration
initiatives.summary: Glencore signed a non-binding memorandum of understanding to potentially sell 40% of its interests in DRC copper and cobalt assets to the US government-backed Orion Critical Mineral Consortium.
